scenes.conflict: Pell insists he needs certainty about the earring's awakening conditions, and Odalys bristles at being handed only the lock, while Marguerite's habit of withholding her plan breeds suspicion.
scenes.goal: Marguerite wants to assign roles for the heist and keep her found family safe from the Lanternwrights' cells.
scenes.outcome: The crew accepts the job with partial information: Pell will research shadow-lore, Odalys will prepare to defeat the reliquary lock, and Marguerite keeps her backup plan secret.
scenes.summary: In the Gilded Lantern Theatre, Marguerite Vane gathers Pell and Odalys and announces the commission to steal the Obsidian Earring from the Duchess's ball. She reveals only the pieces each must play, keeping the full script to herself.
scenes.title: A Commission in the Wings

scenes.conflict: Odalys's recklessness leads her to buy from brokers she has not vetted, and Severin's zealotry lets him ignore the harm he is setting up for strangers.
scenes.goal: Odalys wants the parts and schematics to beat the reliquary lock; Severin wants to learn the thieves' plan and ensure the heist fails.
scenes.outcome: Odalys leaves with sabotaged tools she believes are sound, and Severin learns the crew is heading to the Duchess's ball.
scenes.summary: Odalys visits the Sunken Arcade's black market to gather parts for the reliquary's glass-and-clockwork lock. Severin Hollow, posing as an appraiser, watches her through bribed brokers and has her tools quietly tampered with.
scenes.title: Tools at Low Tide

scenes.conflict: Ilvane's vanity makes her disregard any caution that threatens her image, while Severin must keep his true aim hidden behind compliments.
scenes.goal: Ilvane wants to display the earring and catch the thieves; Severin wants it exposed to the crowd and bright light.
scenes.outcome: The earring is set in a glass reliquary under captured-lightning chandeliers, and the Duchess readies guards to trap the crew.
scenes.summary: In the Aerie, Severin flatters Duchess Ilvane into keeping the earring on bright display for her ball. She brushes aside his hushed warnings and her own fear of shadow loss in favour of showing off her rank, and she resolves to bait and catch the thieves she expects.
scenes.title: Flattery Beneath the Chandeliers

scenes.conflict: Thaddeus's rigid oath-bound hostility toward an ex-apprentice clashes with Pell's anxiety, and neither will admit the Vault's weakness.
scenes.goal: Pell wants confirmation of the earring's awakening lore; Thaddeus wants to capture the Curtain Call Company.
scenes.outcome: Pell leaves with partial but useful lore and without the certainty he craves, while Thaddeus resolves to track the troupe to the ball by signal lantern.
scenes.summary: Pell slips into the Velvet Vault to consult old relic records and meets Warden Thaddeus Brass, who calls him a traitor but cannot hide that the felt walls are failing. Pell learns that relics sleep only in felt-lined darkness, and Thaddeus learns the thieves are targeting the Duchess's relic.
scenes.title: The Warden's Ledger

scenes.conflict: Marguerite's controlling secrecy collides with Pell's fear of acting on uncertain knowledge and Odalys's reckless need to prove her worth.
scenes.goal: Marguerite wants the crew rehearsed and in line; the crew wants to know the whole plan.
scenes.outcome: The crew goes to the ball with fractured trust, a rigged escape route, and no agreed plan for what to do if the earring stirs.
scenes.summary: Back at the theatre, Pell warns that bright light and a crowd of shadows will wake the earring. Marguerite still holds back her backup plan, and Odalys, wanting to prove she is indispensable, insists on a riskier route through the mooring lines.
scenes.title: Rehearsal Without a Script

scenes.conflict: The Duchess's guards and attendants watch every move, and her vanity keeps the chandeliers blazing despite Pell's whispered warning to a servant.
scenes.goal: Marguerite wants to get her crew to the reliquary unnoticed; Ilvane wants to catch her in the act before the court.
scenes.outcome: The crew reaches the reliquary under the full glare of the chandeliers, and the earring begins to hum faintly as the guests' shadows crowd the floor.
scenes.summary: The crew infiltrates the floating ball in disguise. Duchess Ilvane recognises Marguerite and trades barbed theatrical wit with her, content to let the thieves approach the bait while Severin whispers signals through the crowd.
scenes.title: Masks and Chandeliers

scenes.conflict: Odalys is tempted to force the jammed lock at risk to herself, while Marguerite's habit of improvising alone leaves the crew out of step.
scenes.goal: Odalys wants to open the reliquary; Severin wants the earring left exposed under bright light and the heist to fail.
scenes.outcome: The lock stays shut, the earring stirs and the chandeliers flare and flicker, and the crew's cover begins to fall apart.
scenes.summary: Odalys attacks the reliquary's glass-and-clockwork lock, but the sabotaged tools jam it mid-turn. Marguerite starts to improvise alone, ordering Odalys aside, and nearly exposes the whole crew to the Duchess's guards.
scenes.title: The Lock That Would Not Turn

scenes.conflict: His rigid oath and contempt for outsiders block him from believing Pell's warning that the thieves' only chance of stopping the awakening is to work together.
scenes.goal: Thaddeus wants to arrest the crew and secure the earring in a reinforced vault.
scenes.outcome: As aether lamps flicker out around the awakened relic, Thaddeus hesitates to make the arrest, and the crowd's shadows begin to stretch toward the reliquary.
scenes.summary: Thaddeus Brass follows the troupe's signals through the fog and boards the Aerie, cornering Pell and Marguerite beside the failing aether lamps. Before he can seize them, the earring's pulse snuffs lamps across the ballroom.
scenes.title: A Lantern in the Fog

scenes.conflict: Ilvane's vanity and Severin's zealotry both resist surrender, but each must weigh status or devotion against the visible unmaking of living people.
scenes.goal: Ilvane wants to protect her image and her shadow; Severin wants the awakening to complete; the crew and the warden want to stop it.
scenes.outcome: Ilvane orders the chandeliers put out and the relic surrendered, and Severin abandons the awakening to pull his fading follower from the light.
scenes.summary: The Obsidian Earring awakens and the guests' shadows begin to thin and pull toward the reliquary. Duchess Ilvane sees her own shadow fade, and a hooded follower of the Order begins to fade beside Severin as well.
scenes.title: The Earring Wakes

scenes.conflict: The earring's pull intensifies as the mechanical lock refuses to open, and each crewmate must trust the others with a part of the plan they have never rehearsed.
scenes.goal: Marguerite wants to lift the earring and return it to felt-lined darkness before it devours the guests' shadows.
scenes.outcome: The crew shields the guests' shadows and secures the earring in felt, and Thaddeus allows them to carry it to the Vault rather than arresting them.
scenes.summary: In the dimming ballroom, Marguerite hands the real plan to Pell and Odalys. Pell dims lamps and drapes the guests in felt curtains and screens on partial knowledge, Odalys retreats from the jammed lock and passes the job to Marguerite's backup, and Thaddeus lets the crew carry the earring away.
scenes.title: The Whole Script

scenes.conflict: Thaddeus's pride and oath resist admitting that outsiders saved the relic, and Pell is still treated as a traitor.
scenes.goal: Thaddeus wants the earring secured; Marguerite wants her crew to walk free.
scenes.outcome: The earring sleeps again in the Vault, and Thaddeus agrees to let the crew go and to seek their help with reinforcing the walls.
scenes.summary: Marguerite's crew and Thaddeus carry the felted earring to the Velvet Vault and lock it into silence. Thaddeus admits the Vault's walls are failing and accepts that the Guild's methods alone are not enough.
scenes.title: Felt and Silence

scenes.conflict: Ilvane's vanity resists public humility, while the court's rule of theatrical courtesy demands she concede with wit.
scenes.goal: Ilvane wants to salvage her standing; Marguerite wants the crew left alone.
scenes.outcome: The Duchess lets Marguerite's crew leave without reprisal and tempers her ambition, valuing her life over her rank.
scenes.summary: Duchess Ilvane faces her pale, shaken guests and a shadow slow to recover. She concedes that her display nearly cost her court its shadows and trades a wry, subdued bargain with Marguerite.
scenes.title: A Dimmer Ballroom

scenes.conflict: Severin's doubts clash with his devotion, while Odalys must resist the urge to settle the score recklessly.
scenes.goal: Odalys wants answers about the sabotage; Severin wants to protect what remains of his Order.
scenes.outcome: Severin cuts the Order's ties to the brokers and Odalys, supported by her crew, lets him go, ending the sabotage.
scenes.summary: At the Sunken Arcade, Severin quietly breaks with the brokers who sabotaged Odalys's tools. Odalys confronts him about the jammed lock and learns he spared his follower rather than finish the awakening.
scenes.title: Brokers at Low Tide

scenes.conflict: Old distrust of the Guild lingers, and Pell, Odalys and Marguerite must decide whether to accept a truce with their hunter.
scenes.goal: Marguerite wants to keep her found family safe and formalise her new way of leading.
scenes.outcome: The crew agrees to a shared script and a truce with the Lanternwrights, and Marguerite begins a new job with the whole plan on the table.
scenes.summary: Back at the Gilded Lantern Theatre, Marguerite shares a new script with Pell and Odalys, the crew gathered around a table of felt and mirrors. Thaddeus arrives with an offer of cooperation, binding the Company and the Guild in an uneasy truce.
scenes.title: The Next Script

logline: When stage-magician thief Marguerite Vane takes on a commission to steal the Obsidian Earring from Duchess Ilvane's floating ball, she must trust her crew and an unlikely rival warden to return the relic to felt-lined darkness before a hidden cult lets it devour every guest's shadow.
theme: Trust shared is the only light that does not cast a devouring shadow.
title: The Velvet Vault
